properties.headline: Winter Storm Watch issued November 24 at 12:34PM CST until November 26 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
An approaching system is showing an increased risk of producing a
quick bout of heavy wet snow late Wednesday night into Thursday. This
heavy snow could produce substantial impacts to travel for a period
of time on Thanksgiving Day.

* WHAT...Heavy wet snow possible. Total snow accumulations between 3
and 5 inches possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southern Illinois and southeast Missouri.

* WHEN...From Wednesday afternoon through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions could impact the Wednesday evening and Thursday morning
commutes.
properties.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts for updates on this situation.
